// lint-expect: 0
// lint-as: internal/gateway/clean.go
// The shapes L6 wants: httpx.ReadBody for a handler body, a MaxBytesReader for a proxy,
// and LimitReader only on an upstream RESPONSE. Comments may mention io.ReadAll(r.Body)
// and json.NewDecoder(r.Body) freely.

package gateway

func (g *Gateway) handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	reqBody, ok := httpx.ReadBody(w, r, httpx.BodyLimitDefault) // not io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	body := http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, httpx.BodyLimitDefault)
	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), r.Method, "http://identity/x", body)
	req2, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), "POST", "http://practice/x", bytes.NewReader(reqBody))
	resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 4<<20))
	_, _, _ = req2, out, r.Bodyguard
}
